I SCOPE
This standard speci fies the requirements for bicycle front and rear mudguards suitable for popu lar sizes of bicycles. 4 MANUFACTURE. WORKMANSHIP ANI>

FINISH
4.1 The mudguards shall he not less than 50 mm wide and not less than 18 mm deep and shal I be manufactured from steel strip not less than 0.45 mm thickness.

2 REFERENCES
The: following standards co ntain provisions. whi ch through reference in th is text . constitute: provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the poss ibility of applying the mo st recent editions of the standards indicated below :

4.31lle painted parts shall be free from wrinkles. blisters. unevenness. scratch marks and other injurious defects. 5 TESTS

6 MARKING
6.1 The mudguards shall be marked with the manu facturer 's name or trade-mark. The year of manufacture shall also be marked, if required by the purchaser.

and the purchaser, the procedure as given in IS 2500 (Part I) shall be followed for sampling inspection. Th e inspec tio n level and sampling plan as given in 5.1.1 to 5.1.4 shall be followed.

6.2 HIS Certification Marking
The mudguards may also be mark ed with the Standard Mark.

7.1.1 The scale of sampling for dimensional and visu al
characteristics shall be corresponding to the inspection level III as given in Table I of IS 2500 (Part I ) and the sampling plan to be followed shall be corresponding to acceptable quality lim it (AQ L ) value of 4 percent given in Table 2 of IS 2500 (Part I).

6.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the
provision s of the Bureau ofIndian Standards Act. 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licen ce for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to the manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.

7.1.2 The scale of sampling for the tests given in 5
shall be corresponding to inspection level I given in Table 1 ofIS 2500 (Part I) and the sampling plan to be followed for these tests shall be corresponding to acceptable quality limit (AQL) value of 1.5 percent given in Table 2 of IS 2500 (Part 1).
